C0776.title: E-Commerce Cloud Warehouses Implanted with Trojan Software to Steal Express Delivery Label Data
C0776.summary: From November 2021, individuals including Xie, Bao, and Ma implanted Trojan software in over 100 e-commerce cloud warehouses across Zhejiang, Guangdong, Sichuan, and other regions, illegally stealing more than 5 million delivery label records.
